patterns.note: Asymmetrical, organic gradient shapes are integrated into the background of various sections, breaking the clean grid and adding visual dynamism.
Horizontal carousels are used extensively for showcasing company logos and video examples, providing an interactive way to browse content without excessive vertical scrolling.
A vibrant, clear blue (#00C3FF) is consistently used as the primary accent color for all calls-to-action and interactive elements, standing out against the predominantly white and dark backgrounds.
Sections are revealed with a subtle fade-in or slide-up animation as the user scrolls, creating a smooth and engaging content loading experience.
Feature sections frequently pair a concise heading and description with a prominent visual example (video or screenshot) to immediately convey the value proposition.

technique_notes: Uses scroll-triggered CSS keyframe animations to reveal content sections with a staggered fade-in or subtle slide-up effect as they enter the viewport. The hero section features an auto-playing video background.

Organic, fluid gradient shapes are positioned absolutely in the background of sections, often extending beyond the main content area, to add a sense of depth and visual interest without distracting from the primary content.

Implements horizontal carousels for showcasing multiple items (e.g., video examples, partner logos), featuring clear navigation controls and a highlighted active state for the current item, often paired with a descriptive text bubble.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, bold sans-serif headings (~4-5x body) with clear hierarchy, complemented by clean, readable body text and small uppercase labels.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounding for buttons, cards, and image frames.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy, with generous vertical spacing for section breaks and well-distributed content within sections.

standout: The distinctive use of large, fluid, organic gradient shapes that break the traditional grid and extend beyond content boundaries, creating a dynamic and modern visual backdrop for the AI video content.
